note: Author-approved iteration 0 (2026-09-30). Feature definitions unchanged from the approved proposal; development use only, not a frozen release.

binary_terms.description: yes/no and selection wording: whether, either ... or, or not, select, choose

count_terms.description: counting wording: how many, number of

fixed_cost_terms.description: fixed, set-up, start-up, opening or one-time charges

fractional_ok_terms.description: wording that allows fractional or continuous amounts of the decisions (fractional, divisible, non-integer, any amount, need not be an integer)
patterns: \b(?:fractions?|fractional(?:ly)?|divisible|non-?integers?|non-?integral|real[- ]valued|real numbers?|continuous (?:quantit(?:y|ies)|amounts?|variables?|values?)|partial (?:units?|batch(?:es)?|lots?|loads?)|any (?:non-?negative |positive )?(?:amount|quantity)|need not be (?:an )?integers?|(?:does|do) not (?:need|have) to be (?:an )?(?:integers?|whole))\b

integer_terms.description: explicit integrality wording: integer, whole number, indivisible, cannot be fractional

inventory_terms.description: inventory, holding or storage costs, carry-over, backlog

logical_terms.description: logical conditions between decisions: if ... then, if/only if/unless/whenever/provided that + a decision verb, not both, mutually exclusive, only one of, at most k of the, a limit on how many different options/types are used
patterns: \b(?:if|whenever)\b[^.;:?!]{0,100}?,[^.;:?!]{0,60}?\b(?:must also|will also|should also|must not|will not|cannot|can not|can't|may not|should not|is not allowed to|are not allowed to)\b
\b(?:not both|mutually exclusive|(?:cannot|can ?not|can't|must not|may not|should not) both|only one of (?:the|these|those|them)|at most one of (?:the|these|those|them))\b

\b(?:at most|at least|exactly|no more than|not more than|more than|no fewer than|fewer than|up to|only) (?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|\d+) (?:(?:different|distinct) \w+|types?|kinds?|of (?:the|these|those|them))\b

multi_period_terms.description: several time periods: next N months, month 1, planning horizon, two month names

network_flow_terms.description: networks, flows, routes, arcs, nodes, transport and shipping between locations

ratio_percent_terms.description: percentages, ratios, proportions, fractions of a total
patterns: \b(?:at least|at most|no more than|no less than|more than|less than|exactly) (?:half|one half|a half|a third|one third|a quarter|one quarter|two thirds|three quarters)\b
